replicability.2: Needs some resource: a good photo, a person on camera, a product
replicability.3: Any business can do it with a phone

list.title: Reference bank
list.description: Patterns analyzed from real posts. The creation agent uses the published ones; subscribers never see any of this.

filters.search: Search the analysis or the profile

empty.title: No references yet
empty.description: Add a screenshot of a post that worked. The analysis runs on its own and the card lands in review.

emptyFiltered.title: Nothing matches these filters
emptyFiltered.description: Try another niche or format, or clear the search.

new.title: Add reference
new.description: Send the post's images (the screenshot, or the carousel slides in order). The analysis describes the pattern — it never copies the text — and the original image is deleted afterwards.

images.label: Post images
images.hint: Up to {{max}} images, 10 MB each. Keep the post's order.
images.drop: Drag the images here or click add.
images.skipped: Some files were left out: only images up to 10 MB.
images.required: Send at least one image or a direct link to one.

url.label: Post link
url.hint: Kept as provenance. Without an uploaded image, it must be a direct image link.
url.invalid: Use a link starting with https://

channel.label: Source profile
channel.hint: The @ of the account that posted it. The analysis can't mention it.

baseline.label: Account median
baseline.hint: Likes + comments, median of the last 30 posts.
baseline.invalid: Use a number greater than zero.

niche.label: Niche
niche.hint: If you already know; otherwise the analysis suggests one.

terms.label: Banned terms
terms.hint: The brand's name, the people in it, the product. If the analysis mentions any of them, the card can't be published.

new.created: Reference added. The analysis has started.

notFound.title: Reference not found
notFound.description: It may have been deleted, or the link is wrong.

analyzing.title: Analyzing the post
analyzing.description: It usually takes under a minute. This page updates on its own.

failed.title: The analysis didn't come through
failed.failed: The model didn't respond. Try again.
failed.noKey: The model key isn't set up in this environment.
failed.refused: The model declined to analyze these images.
failed.invalidOutput: The answer came back in the wrong shape. Try again.
failed.noImages: The card has no images to analyze.

sections.copyHint: What the text does, never the post's text.
sections.metricsHint: Without all three numbers the card has no relative engagement — and no extra point in search.

fields.suggestedLayoutHint: The Vekoo layout that reproduces the mechanics, in the card's format.
fields.mechanismHint: Why this post works, in its own context.
fields.transferablePrincipleHint: One sentence, niche-free, that holds for any business. Used in similarity search.
fields.whenNotToUseHint: One sentence on where the pattern doesn't fit. The agent reads this before using the card.

review.published: Published. The agent can use this pattern now.

rejectDialog.title: Reject this reference?
rejectDialog.description: It goes to the archive and the agent won't use it. You can reopen it later.

findings.title: Before publishing
findings.copied: Repeats a sentence from the post
findings.noEmbedding: No vector: search can't measure similarity to this card
